purpose: Implement and formally test the exact two-stage value-blind MBO-to-MBP-10 selector authorized for Step 3F.

predecessor_preservation.immutability_rule: Every predecessor verdict and sealed source, protocol, tool, result, report, and manifest remains byte-for-byte unchanged.

frozen_two_stage_selector.name: EXACT_METADATA_THEN_ACTION_OCCURRENCE_V0_1

primary.vendor_occurrence: One-based source_row_ordinal order among all vendor rows with identical primary key.
primary.mbo_occurrence: One-based source_row_ordinal order among all MBO rows with identical primary key.
primary.mapping: Vendor primary occurrence n selects MBO primary occurrence n only when it exists.

frozen_two_stage_selector.fallback_trigger: The primary MBO occurrence selected by metadata does not exist. Book equality or inequality is not part of this trigger.

fallback.vendor_occurrence: One-based source_row_ordinal order among all vendor rows sharing identical K5 and action, including rows that use the primary selector.
fallback.mbo_occurrence: One-based source_row_ordinal order among all MBO rows sharing identical K5 and action.
fallback.mapping: Vendor fallback occurrence n selects MBO fallback occurrence n only when it exists.

frozen_two_stage_selector.selected_state: The reconstructed top-ten book state immediately after applying the selected MBO row.
frozen_two_stage_selector.selection_finality: Once either stage selects an MBO row, that selection is final regardless of subsequent book equality.
frozen_two_stage_selector.unaligned_policy: If neither frozen stage has occurrence n, retain the vendor row as UNALIGNED_RESIDUAL and formal failure.

book_comparison.fields: Bid and ask price, aggregate size, and order count for levels zero through nine.
book_comparison.mismatch_policy: Any unequal field makes its selected row BOOK_MISMATCH and formal failure.

implementations: explicit price-level FIFO reconstruction with independently maintained sorted price index
order-map reconstruction with independently aggregated level index

verdict_rule.PASS: Every formal pass gate is satisfied exactly.
verdict_rule.FAIL_UNALIGNED_RESIDUAL: One or more vendor rows is not selected by either frozen stage.
verdict_rule.FAIL_SELECTED_MBO_REUSE: The frozen selector maps more than one vendor row to the same MBO source row.
verdict_rule.FAIL_BOOK_MISMATCH: Every vendor row is selected without reuse, but one or more selected book fields differs.
verdict_rule.FAIL_REPRODUCTION: The two independent implementations differ on any frozen count, result, or checksum.
verdict_rule.FAIL_INTEGRITY: A predecessor, source, completeness, invariant, or prohibited-work gate fails.

fixed_completion_policy.recommendation: Record PASS or the controlling formal failure honestly, preserve it, and stop Step 3F.

prohibited: modifying any predecessor verdict or sealed artifact
using book equality to choose primary, fallback, or any boundary
triggering fallback because the primary book state mismatches
trying another row after primary or fallback selection
adding, changing, reordering, retuning, or repairing selector stages
dropping, filtering, or repairing unaligned or mismatched records
inspecting market outcomes or directional relationships
